reviews.text:
We’ve been bringing our pup to K9 Loft for three years. The gals who run the front desk are the best (shout out Ash and Jaz!), they’re so welcoming and truly love the dogs. They usually call out her name right when she walks in the door and she’s so happy to see them too. They also do really cute crafts during the holidays with your dog, which is always something we love to see!

We love the text updates with photos, and also get her groomed here. She doesn’t need a lot of shaping with her hair, but the nail clipping, teeth brushing, and gland expression are such a great service. We love this place!

I brought my dog here for solo boarding as she isn’t a fan of other dogs. On the third day I picked my day up from daycare, one of the employees walking a dog on the street cornered us by the front door as we were leaving and the dog they were walking proceeded to attack me and my dog. Since this incident my dog has been terrified of other dogs like never before and has affected our quality of life and anxiety. I received no apology from the staff after 3 of them witnessed this. This was in January, but it’s affected a lot for us. Just beware of their negligence
Love K9 loft!  Vicky is so patient and meticulous to make sure that our Murphy is comfortable and looks great!
My favorite dog groomer in LA!!
K9 Sherman oaks always takes such good care of my senior pup!
Victoria did a great job with Pepsi. He got a bath and brush out and a sani trim. Pepsi is so happy here at the Loft!

My dog Pepsi has been coming to K9 Loft for over a year, and we are so happy. Priscilla is his groomer and she always makes him look so incredibly handsome, we never have to wait very long, and he is always very calm and happy here.

Amazing experience at K9 Loft today! Jenna was incredibly kind, professional, and went above and beyond to help us out. She clearly cares about both the pets and the people — we felt really supported. Grateful for the great team and how smoothly everything was handled!
Kind,  friendly staff! We will be back.

What a poor store....NO SERVICE...AND INSTEAD TO SAY HI AND NOLEGE ME..WHICH I AM BEEN WAITING..THEY TOOK A PHONE CALL..AND INSTEAD TO PUT THAT IN HOLD...THEY HAVE A LONG CONVERSATION..SO I LEFT..AND YOU WILL NEVER SEE A PENNY FROM ME...SIMPLE as that...
We love K9, customer service is amazing. The staff are the best!!!

Absolute best place. Have brought my dog Nuki countless times. Staff is always accommodating, nice and attentive. Priscilla is the main groomer for our pomeranian and she is the absolute best, goes above and beyond for her. Teeth cleaning, paw care, our dogs coat and cuts are always even better than expected. Price is great too.

A homeless man was following me and when I asked for them for help they we quick to invite me in. I was able to stay there until I felt safe and they even offered to walk me to where I needed to go. While I was there I was able to witness their great hospitality and the people and pups walking in were all happy. Simply put they are great. Thank you for helping me in that situation! ^^
Always have a great experience with K9 loft.  Their groomers are amazing and always offer the best customer satisfaction.

K9 Lofts is the BEST!!! I spent this past Summer in LA and needed a daycare for my dog. I'm so sad we don't have one where I'm from. I love the flexibility of drop off and pick up hours and it's very reasonably priced. Also, every staff member I interacted with were so sweet and friendly. I will definitely be using them when I'm in LA next!!
Love K9 Loft! They always do a great job and get mailoh’s haircuts perfect :) everyone is really friendly too!
